# Fictional multi-audience examples

Every company and every value in this directory is fictional. HALV.FAKE denotes
Halvorsen Instruments; BRWB.FAKE denotes Brightwater Bio; CORD.FAKE denotes
Cordell Freight. Amounts in scenario A/B are in supplied millions, except per-share
values, percentages, and counts, which keep their own stated units.

`fpa.csv` supplies the Scenario A currency amounts as a fictional Budget/Actual
example for Maya. `consensus.csv`, `guidance.csv` and `loss.csv` cover scenarios
A/B, `comparison_set.csv` is Dan's supplied model/Street/prior-year comparison,
`panel.csv` is Scenario C (one deliberate unreadable Actual), and `history.csv`
contains Scenario D's eight supplied prior EPS surprises.
